limitations.quote: I’ll apply both operations on the same edge
limitations.note: The edit made recharge cycles deduct a fee instead of preserving recharge priority, while leaving the actual defect untouched: yellow and red remained combinational instead of sampling the pre-update balance on the rising edge.
The test expected the warnings to reflect the post-edge balance immediately and encoded a fee on recharge cycles, so its PASS validated the agent’s assumptions rather than the intended behavior.
A failed Git check delayed the initial inspection, and two separate cleanup errors forced the agent to reissue the simulation command and then clean up in another step.
